cdo.spendInfo.en: What TikTok charged for Studio's ads in the period, from TikTok's own daily report. All: each ad's whole life.
cdo.spendInfo.zh: 该时段 TikTok 对 Studio 广告的扣费，来自 TikTok 的每日报表。全部：每条广告的整个投放期。

cdo.spendSplitInfo.en: TikTok reports spend per ad, not per phone or country, so with one of those picked there is no spend to show.
cdo.spendSplitInfo.zh: TikTok 按广告报告花费，不按手机或国家拆分；选了其中之一时无法显示花费。

cdo.revenueInfo.en: Every payment made in the period (by the day it was paid), after the team's own payments are left out.
cdo.revenueInfo.zh: 该时段内的每笔付款（按付款日计），团队自己的付款不计入。

cdo.roasInfo.en: Revenue divided by ad spend. 1.00× means the ads paid for themselves.
cdo.roasInfo.zh: 收入除以广告花费。1.00× 表示广告回本。

cdo.perBuyerInfo.en: Ad spend divided by the different people who paid after arriving from an ad (TikTok with or without a campaign tag, or TikTok's stored copy).
cdo.perBuyerInfo.zh: 广告花费除以从广告进入后付费的不同用户数（TikTok 带或不带广告系列标记，或 TikTok 的缓存页）。

cdo.buyersInfo.en: Different people who paid. One person paying twice, or on two browsers, is one person.
cdo.buyersInfo.zh: 付费的不同用户。同一个人付两次或在两个浏览器上付费，算一个人。

cdo.chart.en: Ad spend and revenue per day

cdc.col.tiktokInfo.en: TikTok's own purchases (its pixel's Purchase events), over the campaign's whole life. Only a campaign that optimizes purchases has them.
cdc.col.tiktokInfo.zh: TikTok 自己统计的购买（像素的 Purchase 事件），覆盖广告系列整个投放期。只有以购买为优化目标的广告系列才有。

cdc.col.oursInfo.en: People who paid on crazydramas after landing from this campaign or ad (its tag in their link), from our own records: one buyer per person.
cdc.col.oursInfo.zh: 从该广告系列或广告（链接中的标记）进入 crazydramas 后付费的人，来自我们自己的记录：每人算一位。

cdc.why.not_purchases.zh: 优化目标是{goal}：TikTok 不统计购买

cdc.why.outside_period.en: TikTok counts since launch: pick All to compare
cdc.why.outside_period.zh: TikTok 从上线起计数：选“全部”再比较

cdc.why.tiktok_higher.en: TikTok also counts view-through and dates by ad view
cdc.why.tiktok_higher.zh: TikTok 还计入看过广告后的购买，并按看广告的时间记日

cdc.why.untagged.en: {n} buyers arrived without a campaign tag
cdc.why.untagged.zh: {n} 位付费用户进入时没有广告系列标记

cdc.why.untagged1.en: 1 buyer arrived without a campaign tag
cdc.why.untagged1.zh: 1 位付费用户进入时没有广告系列标记

cdc.why.we_higher.en: We saw more: TikTok didn't match everyone
cdc.why.we_higher.zh: 我们看到的更多：TikTok 没有匹配到所有人

cdc.why.info.en: TikTok dates a purchase by when the ad was seen, counts purchases within 7 days of a click or 1 day of a view, and matches people by more than our link tags. We count one buyer per person from our own records, dated when they paid.
cdc.why.info.zh: TikTok 按看到广告的时间记录购买，统计点击后 7 天内或观看后 1 天内的购买，并用链接标记以外的方式匹配用户。我们按自己的记录每人算一位，以付款时间记日。

cdc.noAdSub.en: Direct, organic, or TikTok with no campaign tag
cdc.noAdSub.zh: 直接访问、自然流量，或没有广告系列标记的 TikTok

cdc.periodNote.en: Spend and clicks for the period; TikTok's purchases since launch
cdc.periodNote.zh: 花费和点击按所选时段；TikTok 的购买从上线起计

cdc.untaggedLine.en: {n} buyers came from TikTok without a campaign tag; no campaign can claim them.
cdc.untaggedLine.zh: {n} 位付费用户来自 TikTok 但没有广告系列标记，无法归到任何广告系列。

cdc.untaggedLine1.en: 1 buyer came from TikTok without a campaign tag; no campaign can claim them.
cdc.untaggedLine1.zh: 1 位付费用户来自 TikTok 但没有广告系列标记，无法归到任何广告系列。

cdc.types.info.en: Every ad's numbers added up by the type of the clip it played (set in Clips). Buyers are people whose landing carried the ad.
cdc.types.info.zh: 按广告所用素材的类型（在素材库中设置）汇总每条广告的数据。付费用户指进入时带有该广告标记的人。

cdc.detail.noFile.en: No Studio file for this ad (a Spark code or a TikTok post).
cdc.detail.noFile.zh: 这条广告没有 Studio 文件（Spark 授权码或 TikTok 帖子）。

cdc.detail.ranIn.zh: 在 {n} 个广告系列中投放

cdc.detail.ranIn1.zh: 在 1 个广告系列中投放

cdc.detail.buyers.zh: 来自这条广告的付费用户

cdc.detail.noBuyers.en: Nobody has paid from this ad in the period.
cdc.detail.noBuyers.zh: 该时段内没有人通过这条广告付费。

cdc.detail.notHere.en: That ad has no numbers under this period and filter.
cdc.detail.notHere.zh: 该广告在当前时段和筛选下没有数据。

cdb.none.en: Buyer details arrive with the next crazydramas release.
cdb.none.zh: 付费用户明细将随下一次 crazydramas 发布到来。

cdb.browsersLong.zh: 同一个人用了 {n} 个浏览器

cdb.tl.paywall.zh: 在第 {n} 集遇到付费墙

cdb.person.noSteps.en: No steps recorded for this person yet.
cdb.person.noSteps.zh: 暂无该用户的步骤记录。

cdb.person.notFound.zh: 本报告中没有付费用户 {code}。

cdb.kpi.peopleInfo.en: Different people who paid in the period (crazydramas' person code). One person on two browsers counts once.
cdb.kpi.peopleInfo.zh: 该时段内付费的不同用户（crazydramas 的用户代码）。一个人用两个浏览器只算一次。

cdb.kpi.purchasesInfo.en: Every payment in the period, renewals included.
cdb.kpi.purchasesInfo.zh: 该时段内的每一笔付款，含续费。

cdb.kpi.toPayInfo.en: The middle buyer's time from their first visit to their first payment.
cdb.kpi.toPayInfo.zh: 中位付费用户从首次访问到首次付款的时间。

cdv.info.en: Of the people who started episode 1 (grouped by the day they first opened the series), the share who started each episode. The dashed line is the first locked episode; the marked points lost the most people. This curve follows the period only, not the phone, source or country.
cdv.info.zh: 在开始看第 1 集的人中（按首次打开该剧的日期分组），开始看每一集的比例。虚线是第一集付费集；标记点是流失最多的地方。此曲线只跟随时段，不受手机、来源或国家筛选影响。

lpx.goalNoPurchases.en: TikTok won't report purchases for this campaign; crazydramas still will.
lpx.goalNoPurchases.zh: TikTok 不会报告这个广告系列的购买；crazydramas 仍会统计。
